prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 74.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 62.6%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Visual Pet Style Selection Grid: Rebuild the pet selection screen into an interactive visual grid layout with clear style previews. (why: Adoption stage has a steep drop-off of 37.4% and support tickets note user confusion and custom pet generation failures.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Photo Preview Verification Screen: Insert a photo preview and validation screen right after photo upload to ensure image quality before starting pet generation. (why: Support mails report that custom pet generation fails or looks wrong, driving adoption drop-offs.)
2: [home, wait_info] Generation Progress Time Estimate Display: Display dynamic time remaining estimates and animated progress metrics on the waiting screen while pet assets render. (why: The waiting step has a high median wait time of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading users to abandon the app while waiting.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Benefits and Recovery Info: Add clear guidance on the sign-in screen highlighting cloud backup and pet persistence across re-installs. (why: 8 support emails were received about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Split Layout Path Option Cards: Format the path choice screen into a clear split-column layout contrasting ready-made pets with custom photo generation. (why: Choose path takes a mean time of 514s, indicating user uncertainty when selecting their onboarding route.)
5: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Pet Desktop Spawn Showcase Flow: Add an interactive desktop spawn test screen to verify pet desktop placement and basic interaction prior to completing onboarding. (why: Support tickets highlight cases where pets fail to show up on the desktop or users cannot figure out basic controls.)
6: [sign_in, reorder] Adopt First Sign In Later Onboarding Flow: Shift account sign-in after pet adoption choices so users engage with pet creation before creating an account. (why: Sign-in currently drops 25.3% of users at step 2; deferring auth allows users to build investment in their chosen pet.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Audio Completion Cue: Play a gentle notification chime when pet creation finishes so users who backgrounded the app know their pet is ready. (why: Mean wait time is over 38 minutes (2336s), suggesting users switch windows and forget about onboarding.)
8: [choose_path, copy] Onboarding Story Value Proposition Headline: Update the initial story welcome screen headline and body text to highlight quick 2-minute setup and pet desktop features. (why: Step 1 drop-off is 19.6% with high mean completion time (514s), requiring clearer initial motivation.)
